'''Trost''' is a [[Two Rivers]] youth who now resides in the [[Black Tower]]. He is a Soldier within the [[Asha'man]].

== Activities ==
Trost is part of a group of Two Rivers lads who can [[channel]] and are recruited by the Black Tower. He is part of a team of mostly Two Rivers channelers who are clearing land within the Black Tower with ''[[saidin]]''. He inquires to [[Androl Genhald]] on the status of [[Logain Ablar]] and his team.

== Trivia ==
* Trost is named for Michael Trostler, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
